Created after Wang et al. 2022 [PMID=35627012] who demonstrated the isoamylase activity of the TGAM_1568 protein in Thermococcus gammatolerans EJ3.

Created after Ishikura et al. 2003 [PMID=14614069] who demonstrated the sialidase activity of the SiaHI protein in Tannerella forsythia 92A2. All members of this family possess a N-terminal NAD+ domain.

Created after Strazzulli et al. (2020) [PMID=31595646] who demonstrated the b-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity of the GH109_Pool2 protein from an uncultured archaeon in a metagenomic sample. Initially wrongly assigned to GH109 due to the shared N-terminal NAD+ domain.
Reclassified as GH39 due to high similarity but missing proton donor (E in WNEP)

Created after Al-Jourani et al., 2023 [PMID=37076525] who demonstrated the a-1,5-D-arabinofuranosidase activity of several family members including from Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
Created after Moroz et al., 2023 [PMID=37428847] who demonstrated the muramidase activity of several proteins including in Thermothielavioides terrestris NRRL 8126.
